all_trials.note: a synthetic input has no natural mixing proportion; read the per-stratum biases and the stratified agreement as the primary estimates, the pooled agreement and each mixture as sensitivity checks. Every per-text value and ICC holds for this design's mix of scenarios (a text mixes the scenarios of its block only in expectation: the plan orders the trials by the seed and does not balance them within a text); per_trial gives the per-trial differences by scenario and speed for reweighting to another mix. The per-trial differences include contamination by sessions carried over from an earlier trial; per_trial_uncontaminated restricts them to the trials in neither the carried_out nor the received_carry layer of the prediction (the closing-key trials stay in), and the reweighting to another mix of scenarios is meant for that view; per_trial_layer_none (the trials in none of the prediction's layers) is a diagnostic. Both are null without a prediction. Per-text measures cover the text's trials in the scope
